subthemes.definition: Expressed preference or suggestion about packaging material/environmental impact. Attribute the reasoning to the reviewer; do not treat claims about toxicity or environmental superiority as established.
Reported time or frequency of replacing/recharging energy sources. Does not mean device failure or useful life.
subthemes.related_aspect: Recurring cost of consumables, when explicitly described.

application_policy: Keep original codebook and original coding snapshot. These refinements are not automatically applied to the other 85 reviews; review before final annotation.
